تخانقت (form VI)
# تَخَانَقْتُ (taḵānaqtu) /ta.xaː.naq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
# تَخَانَقْتَ (taḵānaqta) /ta.xaː.naq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
# تَخَانَقْتِ (taḵānaqti) /ta.xaː.naq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
# تَخَانَقَتْ (taḵānaqat) /ta.xaː.na.qat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
